fitReason: Direct learned manipulation and hierarchical RL alignment offer a strong embodied-method match. The lab connects foundation-model training supervision with lightweight deployed control; a reward-learning or policy-evaluation project is plausible research alignment, not a confirmed opening.

physicalEvidence.summary: Full July 22, 2026 VGRS v7 §IV-G deploys simulation-trained hierarchical policies on a Dobot Magician with RealSense D435 for pick/place and bin tasks. It reports five sets of ten trials and 60% success for each task. Physical end-to-end control is20Hz, while approximately500Hz is an inference benchmark, not robot execution. LLM/VLM reward synthesis is training-time only. The collaboration spans UCF, IIT Kanpur and Bath; hardware location/ownership is unspecified. An August 2025 version already had physical trials before Bedi joined its author list, so cap at 20 and do not imply a newly built UCF system.
